newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares down as investors bail out.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares down as investors bail out.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 0.34 percent on Tuesday in heavy turnover as small investors continued to bail out of the market to avoid the looming tax on trading profits, to be introduced on January 1.
"If a lot more small investors decide to sell, shares could continue to fall until the end of the year," one trader said.
* The SBI index fell 3.93 points to 1,163.3.
* Drug maker Lek's A issue was the most active share, easing 0.72 percent to 19,360 tolars on volume of 27,142 shares.
* Turnover jumped to 735.3 million tolars from 250.7 million. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
